component.name: Openbox
component.summary: Highly configurable, next-generation stacking window manager

description.p: Openbox is a lightweight window manager for X11 and Wayland. It provides a fast, modern, and highly configurable environment for managing application windows.

ul.li: Written in Rust for memory safety and performance
CSS-based theming with dark mode support
D-Bus IPC for modern desktop integration
Fixed memory leaks in window management
Improved D-Bus connection stability with automatic reconnection
Fixed CSS theme parser crash on malformed files
Performance improvements: 20% lower CPU usage, 15% faster startup
Improved Python bindings with async support
Enhanced Extension API with hot-reload and messaging

description.p: Initial release of Openbox 4. Complete rewrite in Rust with modern features.
